title: 第13章 谢将军救命之恩第14章 简直是神迹
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 现场血腥味浓郁，尸体横七竖八。
战承胤见到如此一幕，双目赤红，喝道：“全都住手！”
流民们看见大将军带着数百人马，四面八方围困住他们。
抢劫军粮落败了。
他们彻底没了指望。
哐当，不少人手中武器落到地上。
他们知道抢粮会有什么后果，不后悔抢粮！
哪怕是死也认了。
他们后悔的是，死前不能让家里即将被饿死的老人孩子吃上一口饭……
这比砍杀他们还要绝望。
一三十出头的大汉，他手中菜刀落地，跪在地上。
他悲怆道：“大将军，我们知道抢军粮会有什么后果，我死了不要紧，求你给我孩子一口吃的，孩子即将饿死了。”
而他媳妇抱着奄奄一息的孩子，拦在车前，大声哭泣，“当家的，你若死了，我和孩子也不活了！”
说着他媳妇抱起孩子，即将撞墙。
被陈魁一脚踹了回去。
“给老子闭嘴，老子辛辛苦苦守城，死掉几千弟兄，换来你们这群狼心狗肺的抢军粮……”
“大启律法，抢夺军粮一律处斩！”
“来人，把今天抢夺军粮的全部关押起来。”
车前的老弱妇孺，大都是他们家人，想要拦住。
干枯瘦扁的老人倒在路边，若不是浑浊眼珠还能动，怕是以为已经死在路边。
老人眼睁睁的看着孩子抢军粮而被砍死。
在孩子倒下那一刻，老人吊着那口气散了。
还有不少孩子，哭着爬向地上的尸体，抱着尸体痛哭。
战承胤看这一幕心情沉痛的闭上眼。
他计划明早开设粥棚，却没想到今夜有人胆大妄为到去劫军粮。
他悲痛道：“所有抢劫的流民缴械，押到军营充军。”
“在车前拦路者，收拾地上血迹和尸体，军营中登记劳作以抵罪过。”
“传令下去，将军府后巷架锅煮面，全城百姓排队，每人能领到一碗面！”
战承胤话音一落~
所有人跪下，包括附近观望的百姓。
他们全都不可置信，神情悲凉又高兴，笑着笑着又哭了，都用衣袖抹泪！
有粮了！
大将军有粮了！
太好了。
每人能领到一碗面！
这可是面啊！
content_en:
The smell of blood was strong at the scene, and corpses were scattered everywhere.
When Zhan Chengyin saw such a scene, his eyes turned red and he shouted: "Stop it all!"
The refugees saw the general leading hundreds of troops and besieging them from all sides.
The robbery of military rations failed.
They were completely hopeless.
Bang, the weapons in many people's hands fell to the ground.
They know the consequences of grabbing food, and they don’t regret it!
Even if it means death, I will admit it.
What they regret is that they cannot let the elderly and children at home who are about to starve to death have a bite of food before they die...
This is more desperate than killing them.
A big man in his early thirties dropped the kitchen knife in his hand and knelt on the ground.
He said sadly: "General, we know the consequences of robbing army rations. It doesn't matter if I die. Please give my child a bite to eat. The child is about to starve to death."
But his wife, holding her dying child, stopped in front of the car and cried loudly, "Master, if you die, my child and I will not live either!"
As he spoke, his wife picked up the child and was about to hit the wall.
He was kicked back by Chen Kui.
"Shut up, I. I worked so hard to defend the city and lost thousands of my brothers in exchange for you, a bunch of wolf-hearted people, robbing the army..."
"Enlighten the law, and anyone who robs military rations will be executed!"
"Come here and imprison all those who robbed military rations today."
Most of the old, weak, women and children in front of the car were their family members, and they wanted to stop it.
The withered and thin old man fell on the roadside. If his eyes weren't cloudy and still moving, he might have thought he had died on the roadside.
The old man watched helplessly as the child was hacked to death for grabbing military rations.
The moment the child fell, the old man let out a sigh of relief.
There were many children, crying, crawling towards the corpse on the ground, holding it and crying bitterly.
Watching this scene, Zhan Chengyin closed his eyes with a heavy heart.
He planned to open a porridge shed tomorrow morning, but he didn't expect that someone would be bold enough to rob the army rations tonight.
He said sadly: "All the refugees who robbed were disarmed and taken to the military camp to be sent to the army."
"Those who blocked the road in front of the car cleaned up the blood and corpses on the ground, and registered their labor in the military camp to pay for their sins."
"Send the order and set up a pot to cook noodles in the back alley of the General's Mansion. People in the city will line up and everyone will get a bowl of noodles!"
As soon as Zhan Chengyin finished speaking~
Everyone knelt down, including the people watching nearby.
They were all in disbelief, looking sad and happy at the same time, laughing and crying, all wiping their tears with their sleeves!
There is food!
The general has food!
Very good.
Everyone can get a bowl of noodles!
This is noodles!
title_en: Chapter 13 Thank you General for saving your life Chapter 14 It’s a miracle
